visualObservations: Puff-shroom: squat cream/pale-green stalk with flared flat ground base, oversized purple cap with irregular dark purple spots, two dark oval eyes and a small short pale-green trumpet on the stalk front.

Fume-shroom: broad purple spotted cap with a prominent purple front nozzle growing from the CAP, not the pale stalk. Stocky pale-green stem carries dark eyes, sharply pinched brows and a frowning mouth.

Gloom-shroom (PvZ1): rounded purple dome body ringed by short purple open vent tubes; two pale eyes look upward, tiny downturned mouth; only a narrow pale-green base peeks out below. It is not a conventional cap on a long stalk.
canonicalVsProjectStages: All three stage names correspond to canonical distinct game plants. Use each exact identity; do not merely enlarge Puff-shroom.
Fume is deliberately mad in project rules; Gloom can retain its characteristic melancholy/upward gaze without angry brows.
All mushroom stalks/base structures meet the ground directly; never add shoes, feet, arms or a separate leaf pedestal.
productionNotes: Three canonical identities; match Puff/PvZ2, Fume/PvZ2 and Gloom/PvZ1 anatomy.
Purple nozzle originates in cap at stage 1; vent ring replaces the single nozzle at stage 2.
families.handoffHardRules: Friendly, cute; no plant legs/feet; base leaves, roots, pad or pot; Stage 1 Fume-shroom mad; other stages friendly; Mushroom stalk flares to ground; no feet
families.baselineIdentityForComparisonOnly: Purple spotted mushroom and pale stalk; small cap → forward fume horn and mad face → broad cap with a ring of vent tubes. Stalk must flare directly to the ground.

visualObservations: Golden yellow-orange domed mushroom cap with broad irregular orange-brown spots, cream short stalk widening into a continuous flat footless base. Two dark vertical oval eyes with white highlights and a gentle small smile. Cap dominates silhouette.
canonicalVsProjectStages: Sun-shroom is canonical and grows larger in the real games. Big Sun-shroom and Mega Sun-shroom are project stage labels, not separately established canonical species.
Extend the same cap/stalk proportions with increasing size. The old pointed sun-ray rim is a project embellishment, not a canonical Sun-shroom feature; keep cap recognizably mushroom-shaped.
No feet, shoes, limbs or green leaf base.
productionNotes: Do not turn the final cap into a sunflower face or a floating sun.
Support/cheer can use warm cap and stalk motion; separate sunlight effects belong to game renderer.
families.handoffHardRules: Friendly, cute; no plant legs/feet; base leaves, roots, pad or pot; Mushroom stalk flares to ground; no feet
families.baselineIdentityForComparisonOnly: Yellow-orange spotted cap and cream stalk with friendly face; rounded cap grows → broader spotted cap → radiating sun-like pointed rim.

families.name: Cabbage-pult

references.name: Cabbage-pult
references.sourceClass: secondary community host of game render
references.runtimeUse: reference only; generate original pixel art

visualObservations: Round layered GREEN cabbage body sits on overlapping dark-green base leaves. Lighter ruffled outer leaves frame the face. Two black oval eyes with bright highlights and raised leafy brows; no separate mouth in inspected render. A long bent green leaf stalk arches back/up into a cup holding one cabbage payload.
canonicalVsProjectStages: Only Cabbage-pult is canonical. Cabbage Launcher and King Cabbage-pult are project evolutions.
Keep a layered cabbage body and leafy catapult at every stage; stronger arm, fuller leaf crown and restrained final crown are project progression.
Do not turn the head into a generic pea or replace leafy lobber with a wooden siege cart.
productionNotes: Keep bent stalk attached to body through launch/recovery.
The payload is a cabbage in a leaf cup, not a plain green ball; detached projectiles are handled by the game.
families.handoffHardRules: Friendly, cute; no plant legs/feet; base leaves, roots, pad or pot; Stays a cabbage
families.baselineIdentityForComparisonOnly: Layered green cabbage face on base leaves, a leafy catapult holding another cabbage; compact leaves → fuller leaf crown → gold crown nested in leaf crown. It stays cabbage at every stage.

visualObservations: Melon-pult: horizontal squat oval GREEN watermelon body with pale wavy longitudinal stripes; dark oval eyes/brows on front and no mouth. Broad green base leaves. A short curled vine spring connects to a half-melon green bowl cradling an upright full melon payload.
Winter Melon: same oval lobber anatomy in CYAN/ICE BLUE with darker blue stripes, blue vine coil and an icy jagged bowl rim; cool blue-green base leaves. No mouth in inspected render.
canonicalVsProjectStages: Melon-pult and Winter Melon are canonical; Mega Winter Melon is a project evolution.
Stage 0 must retain the project mad heavy brow and mouthless rule, even though this PvZ2 render has a milder brow. Winter stages are friendly.
Preserve spring-vine and bowl geometry; final stage may enlarge icy facets rather than invent a humanoid king.
No legs or feet. Body sits on leaves.
productionNotes: A normal round melon face without rear payload mechanism loses the canonical identity.
Use cold blue/cyan material ramps at winter stages; avoid green recolour alone.
families.handoffHardRules: Friendly, cute; no plant legs/feet; base leaves, roots, pad or pot; Stage 0 mad and mouthless; winter stages friendly
families.baselineIdentityForComparisonOnly: Striped round melon, leaf catapult and no separate mouth at stage 0; green melon → cyan winter melon → large crystal-crowned winter melon.

references.name: Cob Cannon
references.sourceClass: secondary community host of game render
references.runtimeUse: reference only; generate original pixel art

visualObservations: Kernel-pult: upright short GOLDEN corn cob with clearly separated chunky kernels; base wrapped in broad green husk leaves. Two small dark oval eyes beneath drooping green-brown leaf-like brows. A long angular green lobber stalk carries a cup and yellow corn-kernel payload. There is no canonical moustache in the inspected render.

Cob Cannon (PvZ1): huge horizontal yellow CORN COB points forward from a green tapered husk casing with a narrowed stern eye. Body rests on a low brown wooden cart with two visible round pale corn-slice wheels. Organic corn/husk cannon silhouette, no face mouth.
canonicalVsProjectStages: Kernel-pult and Cob Cannon are canonical. Butter-pult is the project middle-stage label; actual Kernel-pult can lob butter as an alternate projectile.
Middle stage should keep corn cob/husk lobber anatomy and put a recognizable pale-yellow butter pat in cup; do not invent a butter humanoid.
Final Cob Cannon is mad and mouthless; real round cart wheels are explicitly allowed. Use intact wheels, not leaf-shaped fake feet.
Old yellow moustache description is a project addition, not required for actual-game resemblance.
productionNotes: Cob Cannon has a horizontal cannon profile; do not scale upright Kernel-pult and call it final stage.
Use base cart and full round wheels in walking/attack/KO frames; no human legs.
families.handoffHardRules: Friendly, cute; no plant legs/feet; base leaves, roots, pad or pot; Stage 2 Cob Cannon mad, mouthless; real cart wheels allowed
families.baselineIdentityForComparisonOnly: Golden corn cob with husk leaves, yellow moustache and lobber arm; kernel basket → butter payload → horizontal cannon cob on a wooden cart with real round wheels.

references.name: Squash
references.sourceClass: secondary community host of game render
references.runtimeUse: reference only; generate original pixel art

visualObservations: Lime-green pear-shaped/squat gourd with a short thick cut green stem, lumpy shoulder ridges and small surface warts. Heavy deeply downturned brow forms one continuous menacing upper face; large off-white eyes with small dark pupils and a pronounced downturned lip/chin. Broad rounded flat ground base, no leaves or limbs.
canonicalVsProjectStages: Only Squash is canonical. Super Squash and Mega Squash are project evolutions.

All stages must look mad with heavy V brow while remaining comic/family-friendly. Increase shoulder mass, gourd size and strong squash silhouette; a final red headband is a project costume detail, not canonical anatomy.
No arms, legs or feet.
productionNotes: Main attack should visibly compress/launch/pound the whole gourd body.
Do not substitute a smiling pear or small green blob with feet.
families.handoffHardRules: Mad at all stages, cute not scary; no legs/feet
families.baselineIdentityForComparisonOnly: Pear-shaped lime gourd with short bent top and heavy angry brows; small gourd → larger angular shoulders → red headband and leafy top.

families.name: Jalapeno

references.name: Jalapeno
references.sourceClass: secondary community host of game render
references.runtimeUse: reference only; generate original pixel art

visualObservations: Glossy RED curved chili pepper, broad upper body tapering into a narrow hooked tip, short green calyx and long curled green stem. Bulging pale pink/off-white eyes with tiny pupils under an angry brow; wide gritted pale teeth and a projecting lower lip. No limbs or leaf pedestal.
canonicalVsProjectStages: Canonical base is Jalapeno. Project stage labels Ghost Pepper and Dragon Pepper are not canonical upgrades of this plant.

Important name collision: this game has a separate ghostpepper family. Do NOT replace Jalapeno stage 1 with the canonical white ghost-shaped Ghost Pepper; keep an evolved darker chili silhouette in this family.
All stages mad. Dragon-like ridges/leaf fins can extend final red chili, but no full dragon head/body/legs.
productionNotes: Keep distinct curled green top stem, red pepper taper and gritted toothy face.
No detached flame effects in character frame sources.
families.handoffHardRules: Mad at all stages, cute not scary; no legs/feet
families.baselineIdentityForComparisonOnly: Red curved chili with green curly stem, gritted teeth and mad brows; small chili → large darker chili → broad dragon-like chili with leaf/fin accents. This family's Ghost Pepper stage is distinct from the separate white ghostpepper family.

references.name: Cactus
references.sourceClass: secondary community host of game render
references.runtimeUse: reference only; generate original pixel art

visualObservations: Tall upright ribbed bright-green cactus with two substantial raised branching cactus arms, clusters of long reddish-orange spines and a tubular forward shooting snout. Narrow pale eyes under flat slanted dark brow. Inspected PvZ2 render has a reddish-orange ruffled flower crown with three yellow stamens and a small brown stone ring at base.
canonicalVsProjectStages: Only base Cactus is canonical; Prickly Cactus and Spike Cactus are project evolutions.
All stages mad. Natural cactus branches are allowed (they are the plant, not human arms); no legs/feet.

Earlier project uses pink flowers, which can be retained as a restrained flower color variant; the inspected actual reference uses warm red-orange blooms. Do not replace characteristic ribbed cactus/snouted silhouette with a generic round succulent.
productionNotes: Preserve long spines and flowering crown at 64px with readable clusters.
Stage growth can raise branches and add ribs/spines/flowers without adding armor or unrelated crowns.
families.handoffHardRules: Mad at all stages, cute not scary; no legs/feet
families.baselineIdentityForComparisonOnly: Green ribbed cactus with large side arms, spine clusters and pink flower; one flower/short arms → taller arms → wide crown of flowers and more ribs.

visualObservations: Spikeweed: extremely LOW flat oval GREEN weed mat, jagged leafy rim, numerous pale yellow tapered conical spikes distributed over its surface. Narrow yellow-green eyelids and tiny reddish-brown pupils near front; no mouth.

Spikerock: squat wide GRAY/STEEL rock or metal-like mound with angular interlocking plates and large faceted spikes/horns. Yellow eyes with red pupils peer from jagged brow below central large spear point. Front has a low armored knuckle-like rocky ridge, no open mouth.
canonicalVsProjectStages: Spikeweed and Spikerock are canonical; Spike Titan is a project evolution.

Major baseline correction: base is a flat green thorn mat, not an ochre/brown hedgehog mound. Preserve a wide LOW silhouette; grow density and rock facets in later stages rather than turning it upright.
Project rules say friendly for this family, unlike stern eyes in inspected PvZ2 render. Keep canonical ground/spike anatomy while softening eye attitude enough to respect project family rule.
No arms/legs/feet.
productionNotes: Even the taller final rock spikes should emerge from a broad rooted ground mat.
Do not add an exposed monster mouth or separate bipedal body.
families.handoffHardRules: Friendly, cute; no plant legs/feet; base leaves, roots, pad or pot
families.baselineIdentityForComparisonOnly: Low ochre thorn mound with eyes, rooted to the ground; modest spikes → rockier mound → tall grey rock spikes over broad brown base.
